messages:
sam_p: FYI — ACME (sales lead) asked for a guaranteed night-time burst for embeddings (12–2am PST). They want 20k qps for a 2h window. Can product + infra size and propose an approach?

jay_sales: they said they'd pay for reserved capacity if we can guarantee throughput. current ask is approximate, will confirm exact token mix tomorrow.

ana_infra: quick clarifying q: is the 20k qps steady for the window or a peak burst? also region?

sam_p: they described it as 'sustained-ish' for the 2h window with occasional 30% spikes for 5–10min. Region: us-west1.

ana_infra: ok. rough calc: embeddings model X on a100 gives ~1.2k qps per GPU for our current config. For 20k sustained -> ~17 GPUs. With 30% headroom and autoscale buffer, we'd want ~24 GPUs in pool during the window.

mike_sre: want to call out cold-start KV priming impact for embeddings — if they hit many unique prefixes, latency may spike. We'll need cache-warm strategy for the canary and burst.

linda_pm: thanks. can we put a concrete autoscaling policy + rollback criteria we can share with sales? Also need cost estimate and launch checklist.

ana_infra: draft autoscale policy below (for discussion):
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 8
  max_replicas: 32
  scale_window_seconds: 300
  burst_buffer_gpus: 8  # reserved for guaranteed window
  target_qps_per_gpu: 1200
  region: us-west1
```
notes: set min=8 to keep baseline latency predictable, burst_buffer ensures we can instantly allocate reserved nodes when window starts.

autoscale-bot: Policy validated against current capacity model. Estimated peak GPUs: 24, avg during window: 18. Estimated monthly incremental cost for nightly windows: ~$9.2k (on-demand) / ~$5.6k (with reserved commit).

jay_sales: price ballpark looks okay. ACME wants SLA for throughput and <200ms 95% latency for embedding lookup responses. Can we commit?

mike_sre: hard to commit sub-200ms 95% for first-hour spikes unless we do warmup and reserve. Recommend: SLA contingent on a warmup run 24h prior + canary night, otherwise we provide best-effort with SLO.

linda_pm: proposed launch acceptance criteria (short):
- confirmed token distribution from ACME (to finalize GPU count)
- autoscale policy merged + infra smoke tested in staging
- warmup/canary run completed with 95th <200ms
- cost & reserve contract option agreed with sales
- monitoring dashboards + alerting (token-level cost, queue depth) in place

sam_p: logistic: I'll ask sales to get token mix and try to get a signed reserve for 3 months. I'll draft a message to ACME asking for a 1-run warmup window.

ana_infra: action items for infra: (1) create a temporary burst pool blueprint in staging, (2) run load test with realistic token mix, (3) add cache-warm priming job and validate latency. I'll file infra-ticket and link here.

mike_sre: SRE: we'll prepare runbook changes for on-call during the burst window, include fallback to smaller model variant if latency breaches threshold.

linda_pm: I'll create the product ticket and acceptance checklist: PROD-6120. Assigning to eng-runtime and infra. Can someone +1?

ana_infra: +1 :thumbsup:

mike_sre: +1

jay_sales: thanks team — keeping ACME updated. will post confirmed token mix by EOD tomorrow. :slightly_smiling_face:

sam_p: perfect. leaving this thread open until we have numbers.

autoscale-bot: Ticket PROD-6120 created and linked to infra-ticket INFRA-2891. Canary run scheduled: 2024-06-03T07:00:00Z.
